PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.

PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH.\pI will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril.\pI have to thank you in some way.\pBecause I am rich, I can give you
anything.\pHere, maybe this will do.
{PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!

PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere.\pIt's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL.\pIt will catch any POKéMON without
fail!\pYou should be quiet about using it,
though.
You have no room for this.
SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\pWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.

Ah, {PLAYER}!
So we meet again!\pThe PRESIDENT and I are discussing
a vital business proposition.\pKeep your nose out of grown-up
matters…\pOr, experience a world of pain!
Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\pBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\p{PLAYER}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\pI must go, but I shall return!
So, you want to see my BOSS?
Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?
Watch your step…\nMy BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!
The monitor has POKéMON on it!
